entities.name: Relation Extraction

entities.description: A method that uses graph-based structures to encode and exploit interdependencies among entities to enhance NLP tasks.

entities.name: Fact Verification
entities.description: A task involving assessing the truthfulness of a factual statement using knowledge graphs.

entities.name: Link Prediction
entities.description: A task involving predicting missing relationships or potential connections between entities in a graph.

entities.description: A task designed to converse with humans using natural language, handling tasks such as answering questions and providing information.
